description: The bar chart illustrates average performance values for five methods associated with the paper “Context-Informed Grounding Supervision.” The horizontal axis contains the method categories in left-to-right order: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, ClnGS (w/), and ClnGS. The vertical axis is labeled “Average Performance” and uses a linear numeric scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at regular 10-unit intervals. Each category is represented by a single solid-colored bar: Standard is orange at approximately 52–53, Self-RAG is a light khaki/tan bar at about 54, FactTune is light green at about 51–52, ClnGS (w/) is steel blue at about 54, and ClnGS is dark blue at about 59–60. The bars are not shown as grouped or stacked, there is no legend, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond distinct bar colors; the categories appear in a fixed labeled order rather than being explicitly sorted by value.
